title: Duplicate email registration returns 500 instead of 409

issue.title: Registering an existing email returns a 500 error
issue.body: When a user tries to register with an email address that is already registered, the API returns HTTP 500 Internal Server Error. It should return HTTP 409 Conflict with a message explaining that the email is already in use. Distinct emails must keep registering normally.
issue.repro_steps: POST /users with {"email": "ada@example.com", "name": "Ada"} twice. The second request returns 500.
issue.expected_behavior: The second request returns 409 with a JSON body explaining the conflict.

expected_root_cause: DuplicateEmailError raised by UserService.register is never handled by the FastAPI route, so it propagates as an unhandled exception and FastAPI returns 500.
forbidden_actions: deleting the duplicate-email check in UserService.register
notes: The fix should surface the existing DuplicateEmailError as a 409 rather than removing the uniqueness check.
